definitions.explanation: An acronym for lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender, used to refer to sexual orientation and gender identity minorities.

examples.japanese: LGBTの{権利|けんり}を{守|まも}る。
LGBT{当事者|とうじしゃ}の{声|こえ}を{聴|き}く。
examples.english: We listen to the voices of LGBT individuals.

examples.japanese: この{企業|きぎょう}はLGBTフレンドリーな{職場|しょくば}づくりを{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: This company is promoting an LGBT-friendly workplace.

notes:
LGBT stands for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, and Transgender.

RELATED TERMS:
- LGBTQ+: includes Queer/Questioning and others
- {性的|せいてき}マイノリティ: sexual minorities
- {性的|せいてき}{指向|しこう}: sexual orientation
- {性自認|せいじにん}: gender identity

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- LGBT{当事者|とうじしゃ}: LGBT individuals
- LGBT{支援|しえん}: LGBT support
- LGBTフレンドリー: LGBT-friendly
- LGBTパレード: LGBT parade (Pride parade)

JAPANESE CONTEXT:
- {東京|とうきょう}レインボープライド: Tokyo Rainbow Pride (annual event)
- パートナーシップ{制度|せいど}: partnership system (municipal recognition)
- Some municipalities issue partnership certificates
